simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כָּסַם (H3697) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: כָּסַם (kâçam) means to shear First listed occurrence: Ezek 44 20.

definitions.full: H3697. kasam [ כָּסַם ] verb shear, clip (Assyrian kasâmu, cut in pieces, according to Dl HWB 344 ); — only Qal Imperfect and Infinitive absolute אֶתרָֿאשֵׁיהֶם יִכְסְמוּ כָּסוֺם Ezek 44:20 they shall by all means clip their heads (opposed to יְגַלֵּ֔חוּ shave and יְשַׁלֵּ֑חוּ , i.e. let grow freely ).
